Name: Emily Replacement Portrait
Author: feralfinch
Description:
Hello! I'm an artist who recently started playing Stardew Valley and fell in love. When I discovered portrait mods and how easy they were to implement, I wanted to try my hand. So I have created a series of vanilla inspired characters with a little more detail and a little more flare.

Emily's original portrait is pretty cute so I didn't want to mess with it too much. I gave her an edgier haircut instead of the "I cut it myself!" look and spruced up her clothes. Since she makes them herself, I wanted the clothes to be somewhat quirky. In my mind, it's the same red dress but with a sheer collared blouse underneath and a bolo tie because what's quirkier than a bolo. Somehow, I think I ended up with a vague Julia Roberts look on the deadpan expression??

+ Requires Content Patcher & SMAPI
[list]
[*]Download my file and unzip
[*]Extract folder into steam/steamapps/common/stardewvalley/mods
[*]Content Patcher must have been run at least once for mods to take effect
[/list]
